title: Payment settings
description: How payments behave at runtime. A change takes effect from the next request, without a restart.
loadFailed: Could not load the payment settings.

empty.title: No payment settings
empty.description: No payment setting is declared on this server.

payment_region_gate_mode.label: Region gate mode
payment_region_gate_mode.description: What the payments region gate does with a request from outside Vietnam: Off places nothing, Shadow only measures, Enforce refuses the payment.

payment_customer_refund_surface_enabled.label: Show the refund offer
payment_customer_refund_surface_enabled.description: Whether the plan-page offer of the change-of-mind refund is shown to members at all. Turning it off hides that offer only; the refund block on a payment page keeps working. On by default.

payment_customer_refund_enabled.label: Refund offer available
payment_customer_refund_enabled.description: Whether the plan-page offer says the change-of-mind refund can be requested right now. It governs only that offer and does not stop requests from the payment page. On by default.

payment_change_of_mind_limit_enabled.label: Limit refund requests
payment_change_of_mind_limit_enabled.description: Whether a member's change-of-mind refund requests are limited to the number below within the window below. When off, a member can request without a count. The limit is advisory while every request is decided by a person, and a failed settings read turns it off. On by default.

payment_change_of_mind_limit_uses.label: Refund requests allowed
payment_change_of_mind_limit_uses.description: How many change-of-mind refund requests a member may have pending or approved within the window. Members who are over it after a change are told when their next request opens. Default 2.

payment_change_of_mind_limit_window_mont.label: Refund limit window (months)
payment_change_of_mind_limit_window_mont.description: How many calendar months back the limit counts a member's refund requests. Default 6.
